articles.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.

articles.title: JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat
articles.snippet: J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions project a 10% annual return for Bitcoin over 10 to 15 years, though the firm isn’t adding it to its main portfolio models.
